description: This file contains functions to traverse a dashboard layout to identify top-level grid and tab components, with caching for performance optimization.

methods.name: findTopLevelComponentIds
methods.description: Traverses the layout to identify top grid and tab level components, returning their details.

methods.name: findTopLevelComponentIdsWithCache
methods.description: Returns cached or newly computed list of top-level component IDs in the layout.
